title: Sandra H NDE 4679
content: See answers to questions below, explains most if not all of experience.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Direct head injury aspirin induced stroke 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' Major subdural hematoma with bleeding into brain, unable to clot due to aspirin usage.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Void | Darkness | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Life review | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal In the void I was very alert to what was happening there.
elements.At what time during the experience were: In the void I was very alert to what was happening there.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning Time did not exist there although it was weeks in the intensive care unit here, in this reality it seemed like a second and eternity there. The darkness was vast, huge; it had no beginning or end. I would stretch out infinitely into it and always it was infinite beyond my sense.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes The beings were in the void with me. I do not know them from this life but seemed to have known them forever. It was like a best friends/teacher reunion.
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Uncertain I knew it was there but could not 'see' it but felt it.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I saw images that told me what I hate the most in others are those qualities I to have but do not see them in myself. I fit very neatly into all the areas I profess to hate in others. Love was the key to everything, acceptance and love. Also there was a lot of 'talk' about my making a decision, the results of the decision. If I returned to the body with pain and paralysis or left for good what would happen. Cannot remember everything often was in void then back out floating near the ceiling, lying above my body, zipping to sneak a look at my charts by floating above the shoulders of the doctors, then back into the void again.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Later, after NDE, I seem to be having a lot of paranormal encounters including being told about future events that came to be.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I became a Buddhist based on certainty of reincarnation.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I became a Buddhist based on certainty of reincarnation.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes See above. As a result of the knowledge I have become a Buddhist.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I try to do what was shown me in the void.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I try to do what was shown me in the void. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Information exchange in the void was done with thoughts/ images that conveyed so much more than words.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I had some abilities before but now it has escalated a hundred percent. I have many encounters now with folks on the other side - some personal in nature some just like bumping into a stranger who wants to talk. Sometimes I will 'see' one turn to notice me when I think to it, interested seemingly or curious about me.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Close family accept what I say, others think I'm crazy. But I'm not crazy my brain damage is not in an area to cause hallucinations.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes Movies, books, but it's really not like those.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real It's profound - you know if you've had one.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real See above, it changed my life.
